name: yf_crypto_info
description:
Profile and market statistics for one cryptocurrency pair from Yahoo Finance (yfinance Ticker.info).
Returns: {symbol, info} where info is Yahoo's dictionary (e.g. name, description, previousClose, dayHigh, dayLow, volume, marketCap, fiftyTwoWeekHigh, fiftyTwoWeekLow).
Inputs (* required): symbol (BTC, ETH, BTC-USD or another pair such as ETH-EUR; upper-cased; "-USD" is appended only when the symbol has no dash; default BTC-USD).
Price history: openbb_crypto_price, av_crypto_daily; broader crypto data: cg_coin_markets.
Example: {"symbol": "ETH-EUR"}

symbol.description: Crypto symbol, e.g. BTC, ETH (USD pair) or BTC-EUR; -USD is appended when there is no dash
